verdict.rationale: Justworks Payroll clearly handles W-2 employees: it collects filing status and withholding at enrollment so employees don't file a W-4 themselves, and it offers payroll reporting. The only sign that contractors are paid on the same platform is a payroll-adjustment article asking for the 'employee or contractor name, payment type, and date of payment.' That implies contractor payments run through Justworks but does not document them. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a contractor payment workflow, 1099 form generation and filing, contractor onboarding, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
